en: A colorized early‑20th‑century postcard showing a young woman and man in formal clothing standing outdoors. The woman wears a long dark skirt, white blouse with pink sleeves, and a straw hat with a ribbon, holding flowers. The man wears a dark suit with a bowler hat, holding a cane and gloves, leaning slightly toward her. Behind them are garden elements such as plants, stonework, and a balustrade with an urn. Handwritten text in a cursive script appears along the right edge and across the lower margin of the image.
